The '''Shashay language''' was the shrieking, chirping language spoken by the [[Shashay]] species from [[Crytal Nest]].<ref name="TA" />

The Shashay had complex vocal cords allowing them to sing very beautiful songs, but at the same time they could not speak [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], only understand it.<ref name="AA">information repeated in ''[[Alien Encounters]]'' and ''[[The Abduction]]'', republished as "The Abduction of Crying Dawn Singer" in ''[[Classic Adventures]]''</ref>
